title: Shared diagonal right-derived-limit interface
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime. For an abelian category $A$ with sequential limits and chosen derived categories of $A$ and of $\mathbb N^{op}$-towers in $A$, a right derived limit is a total right derived functor $R\varprojlim$ of $\varprojlim:\mathrm{Fun}(\mathbb N^{op},A)\to A$ with its universal unit, computed on K-injective towers, together with its tower projections. On the small pro-étale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] of a scheme $X$ let $\mathbf Z_{\ell,X}=\varprojlim_n(\mathbf Z/\ell^{n+1})_X$; the category of $\mathbf Z_{\ell,X}$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], the restriction of scalars from it to modules over the constant ring $\underline{\mathbf Z_\ell}$ along the coefficient map induced by all finite quotient projections [def-sfb-constant-ring-module-restriction], and the Tate twists $(\pm1)$ given by tensor product with the completed Tate line of [sk-def-sp-tate-twist] and its dual. For the diagonal surface of [def-sfb-diagonal-system-interface] and a chosen derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], define the completed source unit, the degree-zero and shifted single-object limit comparisons, the finite-cycle normalization of a strict-system Ext class, the compatibility of a completed arrow with its finite quotient units, and the simultaneous finite and completed normalization predicate of an integral boundary class. These are data and propositions, not the assertion that they hold.
